lines.text: Alright, that should cut off the flow of lava to the room with the Reaverbot.
Now all we have to do is figure out how to defeat the Reaverbot, and we're set!
Good idea, Bon! Well then why don't we get him to do our work for us?
Now that his energy supply's been cut off,
that Reaverbot's defenses should be weakened enough that he can be damaged.
I'll bet that once he's defeated, we'll be able to get the key!
Alright then, our alliance is over!
Next time we see each other, we're enemies again, understand?
Well, you look like you're having fun.
Huh? No, of course not. Hehe... Why would you say that?
Anyway, we have to make sure we get to the key first. Ready?
